corrections.old_text: ፲፯ ፳፩ ፱ ፴ ፱ ፵፬
corrections.corrected_text: ፲፯ ፳፪ ፱ ፴ ፱ ፵፬
corrections.reason: The verse numeral under Matthew chapter 17 is clearly printed as ፳፪ (22), corresponding to Matthew 17:22 (ሀለዎ ለወልደ እጓለ እመሕያው).
The printed glyph has the 2nd-order (ካዕብ) side stroke on the right leg (ትኩን, Ge'ez subjunctive of ከዊን), not the 7th-order ring.
Canonical Ge'ez Gospel phrasing (Mark 11:4) and the printed glyphs clearly show እሱረ ('a tied colt', ዕዋለ እሱረ), which Stage 1 misread as አውራ.
Faint verso show-through in the space after ብእሲ was misread as አ; the printed Ge'ez text (Matthew 21:33 / Mark 12:1 / Luke 20:9) is ብእሲ ተከለ ወይነ ።
Both words carry the 7th-order (ሳብዕ) vowel ring in the image: ወነቢሮ ፍጽሞ ('And sitting opposite [the treasury]', Mark 12:41).
The initial character is 1st-order አ (አሚሃ, 'then / at that time', Matthew 24:30), not 6th-order እ.
